name: Runa Srivastava

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Runa Srivastava is a poet and writer with an academic background in science. Her work appears in literary journals, including Eexpression, and her poetry collection Epistle in Sunlight is listed by Penprints. The combination of scientific study and literary practice connects her contributor biographies across these publications.

The sea is a companion in both poems gathered here. In “Life is as inexorable as the sea”, its enduring presence links childhood trust with a later need for reflection. “The sea, My solace” follows a quieter movement from listlessness towards renewal, as the rhythm of waves begins to restore the speaker’s sense of possibility.
